channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: There is no ‘now’ in a distributed system
Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
item.description: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Rewinding the exponential: How we keep hardware usage down
Beyond API Compatibility: Building a Tool to Measure the Blast Radius of Library Changes
Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
item.description: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world. (1 source: cloudflare)
